title: Three-factor product-key beam recovery frontier
question: Can increasing beam within the 3-factor, factor-size-8 product-key construction recover capability while remaining materially sparser than the validated two-factor frontier?
hypothesis: Beam increases should recover proposal coverage while increasing the selected-cell union, potentially exposing an intermediate capability/computation region.

arms.name: three_factor_8_beam3
arms.intervention: three-factor product-key addressing, factor size 8, beam 3

arms.name: three_factor_8_beam4
arms.intervention: three-factor product-key addressing, factor size 8, beam 4

arms.name: three_factor_8_beam5
arms.intervention: three-factor product-key addressing, factor size 8, beam 5

arms.name: three_factor_8_beam6
arms.intervention: three-factor product-key addressing, factor size 8, beam 6

endpoints.name: target_recall_retention_ratio
endpoints.role: capability retention versus exhaustive cosine reference

decision_rule.condition: For three_factor_8_beam3, three_factor_8_beam4, three_factor_8_beam5, and three_factor_8_beam6, report exact pooled target recall, capability retention, proposal retention, states scored/M, end-to-end success, arithmetic, routing operations, and occupancy at each M.
decision_rule.does_not_license: universal optimal beam, semantic retrieval, asymptotic guarantees, or hardware speedup

decision_rule.condition: A configuration is capability-qualified only if exact pooled target_recall_retention_ratio is at least 0.85 at every M level.
decision_rule.licenses: that configuration meets the preregistered capability floor on this workload
